qualifier: 3'-end trimming of noncoding RNAs
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay and noncoding RNA 3'-end trimming
rationale: All members are nuclear RNA exosome activities (degradation of CUTs, snRNA, rRNA, surveillance of nuclear mRNA and 3' trimming of snoRNA and 5.8S rRNA), unlike confusables centred on endonucleolytic pre-rRNA processing, ribosome biogenesis or cytoplasmic 3'-5' mRNA decay.

qualifier: eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
name: Th2-driven eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-5 production and eosinophil/mast cell development, migration and activation, whereas confusables emphasise IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signalling, negative cytokine regulation and IgE switching.

core: Innate receptor activation of NF-kB and stress MAPKs
qualifier: TAK1/IKK downstream of TLR and NOD receptors
name: TAK1-mediated NF-kB and JNK/p38 activation by TLR, NOD receptors
rationale: Members are positive TAK1/IKK-driven NF-kB, JNK and p38 activation from TRIF/IRAK TLR, NOD1/2, Dectin-1 and TNFSF inputs, while confusables focus on TNFR1 signalling, negative NF-kB regulation, linear ubiquitination or TBK1/IRF3.

qualifier: with peroxisome biogenesis and sterol/isoprenoid biosynthesis
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism, peroxisome biogenesis and sterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisomal protein import, VLCFA and alpha-oxidation, ether lipid synthesis and mevalonate-cholesterol synthesis, distinguishing it from bile acid, mitochondrial beta-oxidation/BCAA and CYP-defect confusables.

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis, degradation and response
name: Vitamin A and retinoic acid metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinoid/terpenoid metabolism and retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26 catabolism and response, unlike confusables on vitamin D/K metabolism or the visual retinoid cycle.

qualifier: endogenous ligand sensing in myeloid cells and DCs
name: Monocyte and myeloid inflammatory TLR signalling to endogenous ligands
rationale: Members combine inflammatory/TLR signalling, endogenous ligand and heme sensing and monocyte/DC modules, whereas confusables centre on LPS/lipopeptide detection or neutrophil degranulation.

core: Renal control of water, sodium and blood pressure
qualifier: by vasopressin and renin-angiotensin
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin regulation of renal water and pressure
rationale: Members cover vasopressin receptor signalling, angiotensin generation, renal water/sodium handling and blood pressure, distinguishing it from osmotic-stress/aquaporin and natriuretic cGMP confusables.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 via STAT5
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 common gamma-chain signalling
rationale: All members are IL-2, IL-7 or IL-9 receptor signalling (with IL-2/STAT5 targets), unlike confusables on IL-3/IL-5, FLT3/STAT5 or IL-15/IL-21/IL-12-family cytokines.

qualifier: maintenance and apoptotic cleavage
name: Epithelial apical junction adhesion, maintenance and apoptotic cleavage
rationale: Members concern epithelial cell-cell junctions, adherens junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, while confusables emphasise polarity, desmosomes, junction assembly or cadherin trafficking.

qualifier: endosomal AMPA receptor recycling in synaptic plasticity
name: Postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter/AMPA receptor internalisation, endosomal recycling, postsynaptic calcium and actin, LTD and memory, distinguishing it from presynaptic, BDNF and receptor-clustering confusables.

qualifier: short/medium-chain acyl-CoAs and NAD(P) cofactors
name: Peroxisomal medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix housekeeping of medium-chain, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA, NAD transport/NADP synthesis and TYSND1 processing, lacking the VLCFA and alpha-oxidation pathways of the confusables.

core: Fibroblast fate in fibrotic tissue repair
qualifier: with miRNA biogenesis regulation
name: Fibroblast fate in fibrotic repair and miRNA biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members combine fibroblast/myofibroblast apoptosis and differentiation in connective tissue repair with regulation of miRNA transcription and processing, the latter being what separates it from TGF-beta/ECM fibrosis confusables.

qualifier: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte development
name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation/differentiation, megakaryocyte and platelet development and RUNX1 transcriptional control, while confusables are erythroid, granulopoietic or monocyte-focused.

qualifier: Nudix hydrolase phosphate bond hydrolysis
name: Nudix hydrolase nucleoside triphosphate catabolism
rationale: All members are NTP breakdown by NUDT phosphohydrolases, distinct from confusables on deoxynucleoside catabolism, purine salvage or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: ChREBP regulated by PKA, PP2A and AMPK
name: Glucose-sensing ChREBP transcription and PKA/AMPK metabolic control
rationale: Members concern sugar-regulated transcription via ChREBP and its PKA/PP2A/AMPK/PDE3B control of lipid and gluconeogenic output, unlike confusables driven by LXR, SREBP, PPARA or glucagon response.

qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation in lung and limb bud
name: Mesenchymal proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in lung, limb
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and mesenchymal proliferation in lung and limb bud development, whereas confusables concern glandular epithelial branching in prostate, salivary gland or pancreas.

qualifier: epithelial lineages, branching and lactation
name: Mammary gland development, epithelial lineages and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary epithelial lineages, ductal/alveolar development and lactation, unlike prostate, reproductive tract, trophoblast or involution confusables.

qualifier: acyl-CoA oxidase pathway for very long-chain fatty acids
name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very long-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members are ACOX-driven peroxisomal beta-oxidation of VLCFA, pristanoyl-CoA and acyl-CoAs including ABCD1 defects, lacking the alpha-oxidation, ether lipid, elongation and acyl-CoA hydrolase pathways of confusables.

qualifier: PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin
name: PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of PC/PE/PS/PG/cardiolipin via CDP intermediates plus lysophospholipid hydrolysis and cardiolipin remodelling, distinguishing it from Lands-cycle acyl remodelling and PI synthesis/transport confusables.

qualifier: PLK1/Aurora A kinases and spindle checkpoint
name: PLK1/Aurora A-driven mitotic entry, spindle assembly and checkpoint
rationale: Members cover PLK1, AURKA and NEK kinase control of G2/M, centrosome separation, spindle formation and checkpoint signalling, unlike cytokinesis, centrosome maturation or sister chromatid cohesion confusables.

qualifier: Fas ligand-mediated T cell activation-induced death
name: FasL-mediated T cell apoptosis and activation-induced cell death
rationale: Members concern Fas/FasL signalling, BID activation and T cell/thymocyte death and allograft rejection, distinguishing it from TRAIL and generic extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: biogenesis, RISC assembly, miRNA turnover and mRNA destabilization
name: miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, turnover and mRNA destabilization
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC loading, target-directed miRNA decay and silencing by mRNA destabilization, unlike confusables on siRNA, translational repression or P-body deadenylation.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids and drug metabolism
rationale: Members are glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with CYP2E1 and paracetamol, aspirin and prednisone ADME, distinguishing it from acetylation/methylation and other drug ADME confusables.

qualifier: lestaurtinib, ponatinib and tamatinib
name: FLT3 mutant resistance to lestaurtinib, ponatinib and tamatinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to these three inhibitors, distinguishing them from KIT resistance, FLT3 signalling and FLT3 resistance to other inhibitors.

qualifier: caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
name: Pyroptosis via caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: Members are pyroptosis and the noncanonical caspase-4/5, AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes, unlike confusables centred on NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1/IL-18 processing and signalling.
